versions.changelog:
**Security and stability update – adds strict argument handling for chart CLI calls.**

- Enforces argv-style argument passing for CLI invocations; prohibits shell-built command strings.
- Prevents interpolation of user-influenced data, labels, or content into shell commands.
- Only allows inline JSON for `data` and `variant` when passed as structured argv arguments.
- Improves clarity that all CLI execution must follow strict, structured argument usage.

No file changes detected in this version.

- No updates, fixes, or new features introduced.
- Skill behavior, rules, and documentation remain unchanged from the previous version.

- Added a summary "Why This Skill" section to highlight key capabilities and advantages.
- Clarified that the runtime does not use Chromium, Playwright, or browser automation.
- Provided a link to a dedicated configuration page for style fine-tuning.
- Simplified and reorganized introductory material for easier audience understanding.
- No code or behavior changes; documentation update only.

No user-facing changes in this version.

- No file changes detected; all documentation and functionality remain the same.

- Refined routing rules: Only route plain "data analysis" or similar requests here if the user clearly asks for a chart or visualization.
- Streamlined chart triggers to focus on explicit chart/visualization intent, supporting both English and Chinese keywords.
- Clarified directory references and stable cross-platform output paths for chart images.
- Detailed when to deliver output file paths vs. images, with priority logic for coding/file workflows and channel capabilities.
- Improved guidance on preparing data, config, and variant payloads for consistent and stable rendering.

- Switched from remote CLI (npx) to a local runtime: npm install now required in the skill directory before use.
- To run, use ./node_modules/.bin/areslabs-data-charts from the local skill folder.
- Updated metadata to require "npm" and "node" instead of just "npx".
- Added package.json for local dependency management.
- SKILL.md execution instructions revised to clarify setup and command usage.

No code or config changes detected in this release.

- No file changes; documentation references updated to use relative paths.
- No new features or behavioral modifications introduced.
- Internal documentation links now point to relative paths for improved portability.
- No impact on user-facing functionality.

- Documentation was updated with minor edits and wording changes.
- Clarified that the skill is built on ECharts.
- No functional, interface, or behavioral changes in this version.

- Showcase section updated: now features a single composite image displaying supported chart types instead of a multi-image table.
- No functional or behavioral changes; all routing, operating model, execution rules, and chart type guidance remain unchanged.
- Documentation is now more concise and visually streamlined for easier skill discovery.

- Improved the "Showcase" section formatting to use a Markdown table with chart images for better readability.
- Updated guidance in the "Execution Rules" and "Delivery Rules" sections for greater clarity.
- No logic or code changes; documentation and formatting improvements only.

- Adds a new "Showcase" section with chart image examples for each supported chart type.
- Improves the summary with clearer highlights of ECharts-style alignment and browser-independent image rendering.
- Expands chart type documentation to show direct support for donut, rose, and bubble styles via mapping.
- No changes to logic or execution; documentation and guidance are clarified and more visual.
- No functional or CLI interface changes.
